correctness.rationale: For every finite abelian action, equivariant maps G/H -> G/K exist exactly when H is contained in K and have [G:K] phases. Regularity equals a section over every image orbit, characterized by equal-stabilizer preimages. Selecting image orbits then enforcing that each chosen same-type orbit is hit from a source of that type via inclusion-exclusion proves the full formula without overcounting. Empty cases and the prime-cyclic limit are covered. Independent witness-enumeration checked 3253 maps, 1793 regular, in four test actions.

value.rationale: A complete multivariate image-orbit invariant for regular elements of End_G(X) over every finite abelian group and action, providing more information than monoid cardinality, subgroup generator rank, or overall regular count. Prime-cyclic asymptotic quantifies a persistent nonregular stratum in a natural increasing-orbit family, supplying a concrete structural use.
